t: 斯特凡·杜尚（Stefan Dušan），“强大的”，在斯科普里加冕为塞尔维亚人皇帝，他的帝国…
te: Stefan Dušan, "the Mighty", is crowned Emperor of the Serbs at Skopje, his empire occupying much of the Balkans.
dz: 斯特凡·杜尚（Stefan Dušan），“强大的”，在斯科普里加冕为塞尔维亚人皇帝，他的帝国占领了巴尔干半岛的大部分地区。
de: Stefan Dušan, "the Mighty", is crowned Emperor of the Serbs at Skopje, his empire occupying much of the Balkans.

t: 夏尔四世,卢森堡伯爵和波希米亚国王,被选为罗马人国王.
te: Charles IV, Count of Luxembourg and King of Bohemia, is elected King of the Romans.
dz: 夏尔四世,卢森堡伯爵和波希米亚国王,被选为罗马人国王.
de: Charles IV, Count of Luxembourg and King of Bohemia, is elected King of the Romans.

t: Jaume Ferrer从马略卡出发前往"黄金之旅",塞内加尔河.
te: Jaume Ferrer sets out from Mallorca for the "River of Gold", the Senegal River.
dz: Jaume Ferrer从马略卡出发前往"黄金之旅",塞内加尔河.

t: 在克雷西战役中，一支英国军队轻松击败了一支两倍于其规模的法国军队。
te: At the Battle of Crécy, an English army easily defeats a French one twice its size.
dz: 百年战争：在克雷西战役中，一支英国军队轻松击败了一支两倍于其规模的法国军队。
de: Hundred Years' War: At the Battle of Crécy, an English army easily defeats a French one twice its size.

t: 英国人在内维尔克罗斯俘虏了苏格兰国王大卫二世并监禁他11年.
te: The English capture King David II of Scotland at Neville's Cross and imprison him for eleven years.
dz: 英国人在内维尔克罗斯俘虏了苏格兰国王大卫二世并监禁他11年.
de: The English capture King David II of Scotland at Neville's Cross and imprison him for eleven years.

dz: 1346年7月11日在伦斯被选为德国国王后,查理四世被波恩的科隆主教瓦尔拉姆加冕为德国国王.
de: Having been elected German king at Rhens on 11 July 1346, Charles IV is crowned King of Germany by bishop Walram of Cologne in Bonn.
